notes.title: THE MAGISTER – NEW NERDOOK GAME IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]It's sleuthin' and deducin' time! The Magister - the new game from Reverse Crawl developer, Nerdook - has finally arrived and there's a murder to solve in Silverhurst! [/b] Step into the shoes of a Magister, gather clues, discover motives, and unmask the guilty culprit! Build a deck and use a vast array of cards to fight or negotiate! 

[list]
[*] Randomly generated murder-mystery means every playthrough is different!
[*] Use physical, weapon, and magic cards to overpower enemies in battle
[*] Master 'Tactical Diplomacy' with conversation cards for peaceful outcomes
[*] Variety of Magisters to play as, each with their own specialties and flaws
[*] Recruit an ally to help, including a cat or dog companion to fight alongside you 
[/list]
The Magister is available to purchase and download now from the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/]store page[/url][/b], and you can grab it with a 15% launch discount for a limited time. You can also pick it up on Nintendo Switch, and it'll arrive tomorrow (3rd Sept) on Xbox One.

[previewyoutube=JqCM-C5IbZg;full][/previewyoutube]
For a taster of what The Magister has to offer, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716720/The_Magister__The_First_Two_Days/]download The Magister: The First Two Days for free here[/url]. It gives you the first two days of an investigation to play through (in the full game, investigations take place over 14 days).

We hope you enjoy The Magister! If you do, please leave a review – it really helps. Thank you for the support!

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/

notes.title: THE MAGISTER - NEW NERDOOK GAME LAUNCHES SOON!
notes.content:
Wanted to let you all know that [b]The Magister, the new game from Reverse Crawl developer Nerdook, now has a release date – the murder-mystery card battler will launch September 2nd on Steam[/b] (and Nintendo Switch, and also for Xbox One on Sept 3rd)! If you haven't already, be sure to add it your wishlist and you'll be alerted the moment it's available.

[previewyoutube=JqCM-C5IbZg;full][/previewyoutube]
Before the full game launches, we're also going to be releasing [b]The Magister: The First Two Days[/b] to give you a chance to sample the action and start your investigation early. As the name suggests, it will include the first two days of the randomly-generated whodunnit adventure (the full game takes place over 14 days). We'll provide an update when it's available, but rest assured that it will be available to download from Steam for free sometime before September 2nd.

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: The Magister demo – play the new game from the Reverse Crawl dev!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/400660/announcements/detail/2215154055541796514]I shared the news with you recently[/url] that Reverse Crawl developer Nerdook is working on a new game: a murder-mystery RPG card-battler called The Magister. Well, I'm delighted to say you can now try a demo of The Magister by downloading it from the game’s Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/][b]download the demo here[/b][/url]! 

The demo has been released as part of the Steam Game Festival and it’s the first time The Magister has been publicly playable anywhere! It’s a WORLD PREMIERE!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mlT2Wzw.gif[/img]


In the demo you can...
[list]
[*] Play through the first two days of the murder investigation
[*] Sample the card-based battling and tactical diplomacy 
[*] See how different combinations of traits define your Magister and the overall experience
[*] Get acquainted with the places and people of Silverhurst
[/list]

The demo will only be available for the duration of the Game Festival i.e. it will be removed on Monday 22nd June at 10AM PDT, so be sure to download and play it before then.

If you enjoy the demo and want to stay updated about The Magister, please go ahead and do any/all of the following: 
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/]Wishlist The Magister[/url][/b] (be notified when the game launches or goes on sale)
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/][b]Follow The Magister[/b][/url] (be notified whenever we post news to the Steam page)
[*] [b][url=https://www.digerati.games/newsletter]Join the Digerati mailing list[/url][/b] (stay updated on ALL Digerati games)
[/list]

Your support is really appreciated – thank you.

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: The Magister – a new murder-mystery RPG from Nerdook!
notes.content:
Exciting news – the one-man Reverse Crawl developer, Nerdook, has just revealed a brand-new game! The Magister is a murder-mystery RPG and deck-builder set in a hand-drawn fantasy world. The game will launch later this year, but in the meantime, you can find full details, along with a trailer and screenshots, over on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/][b]The Magister game page[/b][/url]. Add the game to your Wishlist while you’re there – all support is hugely appreciated!

To celebrate the unveiling of The Magister, Nerdook’s previous games are now on sale! Hit the links below to take advantage of some generous discounts:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/496620/Monster_Slayers/]Monster Slayers[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/400660/Reverse_Crawl/]Reverse Crawl[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/311480/Vertical_Drop_Heroes_HD/]Vertical Drop Heroes HD[/url]
[/list]
I can also give you a very sneaky heads-up on the news that a demo for The Magister is coming soon. There will be more details on The Magister page closer to the time, but if you give the game a ‘Follow’ you’ll be alerted when the demo goes live. 

Hit the widget below and you’ll be whisked to The Magister page, where you can discover more about Nerdook’s latest, and click on those all-important Follow and Wishlist buttons :)

We look forward to you enjoying The Magister in the very near future!

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the third update for Reverse Crawl: 

Changelog v 1.0.0.3
================ 

- Fixed the Cache mission and remaining Siren bugs. 
- Added an Upgrade Tree. Accessible from the main quest screen and after missions, it allows you to have greater control over your upgrades and specializations. Each level up grants you points that you can spend in one of six upgrade categories!
- Rebalanced the Endless mode to scale better over time.

Mini update (15 Oct)
- Fixed Marksman level 1 in the Upgrade Tree.
- Reworked New Game+ a little: all heroes are now available from the start (except for the final two classes), and the hero missions have been reworked/removed in New Game+

As always, if you come across any new bugs or have some feedback, head along to the community forums and let me know! Thanks guys!

notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the second update for Reverse Crawl:

Changelog v 1.0.0.2
================

- Guard command nerfed. It now heals less damage, and damage reduction from the next missile is reduced to 35% from 50% originally.
- Reworked the "Threatening" trait to only trigger with a 15% chance each round. It was way too powerful before, and has been toned down now.
- Reworked the "Holy Light" ability, it now only has a 33% chance to reduce 1 Threat, instead of 100% chance of reducing Threat by 2 originally.
- Fixed Cache mission: choosing Violet early will no longer make the mission unwinnable
- Fixed Siren bug: having no enemies remaining when dominated will no longer freeze the game
- You can now alt-tab out of the game without it crashing.
- Various smaller bug fixes.

As always, if you come across any new bugs or have some feedback, head along to the community forums and let me know! Thanks guys!

notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the first update for Reverse Crawl:

Changelog v 1.0.0.1
================

- You can now use the Guard command even when Stunned, so that you can always skip a turn by Guarding instead. It can even be used if there is a Magehunter on the field.
- Fixed Sirens so that a dominated creature's turn automatically ends when there are no enemies left on the field.

I've got bigger changes planned in future updates, so stay tuned! In the meantime, keep leaving reviews if you enjoy the game, take some screenshots, and feel free to ask questions on the discussion boards. Cheers!
